name_reason: The trailing _51a59 suffix equals the symbol's own address (0x51A59) -- a Ghidra address residual, not a domain ID. The descriptor fdfield_dat already fully identifies the string. Sibling resource-filename strings without collisions (fdtxt_dat, fdother_dat, fdmus_dat, tai_dat) carry no address suffix; dropping _51a59 makes naming consistent and removes the residual per the naming rule. Rename recorded only; to be applied in Stage 2.
purpose: Read-only NUL-terminated ASCII string "FDFIELD.DAT" -- the filename of the per-chapter field/battle resource archive, passed as the path argument to fd2_load_dat_resource.
logic_summary: Static const char[12] = {'F','D','F','I','E','L','D','.','D','A','T',0}. The address is taken (PUSH 0x51A59 / array decays to char*) and handed to fd2_load_dat_resource, which fopen()s the archive and extracts the requested entry index. Entries are addressed per chapter as chapter*3 (battle tile map), chapter*3+1 (tile-event data table) and chapter*3+2 (portrait load buffer); fd2_chapter_23_end additionally reads the fixed index 0x45 for its second battlefield.
element_semantics: Each byte is one ASCII character of the filename literal "FDFIELD.DAT" (offsets 0..10) followed by the NUL terminator at offset 11; consumed byte-wise as a C string (char*).
comment_original_issue: The src comment stated that both fd2_load_save_and_init_engine and fd2_load_chapter_battle_data 'load three indices per chapter', but only fd2_load_chapter_battle_data loads all three FDFIELD.DAT indices; the save-load path loads only chapter*3 and chapter*3+2 (it restores the tile-event table from FD2.SAV). It also omitted the fixed index 0x45 used by fd2_chapter_23_end. Refined for per-reader precision.
notes: Content verified by read_memory @0x51A59 = 46 44 46 49 45 4C 44 2E 44 41 54 00 ("FDFIELD.DAT\0"). Readers verified by decompiling fd2_load_chapter_battle_data (3 loads: chapter*3+2,+1,+0), fd2_load_save_and_init_engine (2 loads: chapter*3+2 scratch, chapter*3 tile map; tile-event table from SAV pBuf), fd2_load_chapter_portraits_and_dump_tmp (re-load chapter*3+2), fd2_chapter_23_end (fixed idx 0x45). All 7 xrefs are DATA reads, zero writers -> is_const=true. Ghidra annotation had been placed on PRE_COMMENT (wrong field per project_ghidra_data_plate_mechanism) with PLATE empty; moved/created the refined plate on PLATE_COMMENT and cleared PRE_COMMENT.
